description.message: Translate selected tabs using an on-device model.

menuTranslatePage.message: Turn translation on for this tab

menuRestorePage.message: Turn translation off and restore this tab

content_debugPass.message: $1$ nodes this pass · $2$ translated · $3$ failed · $4$ planned

popup_enabledTitle.message: Enable or disable translation for this tab only.

popup_localUnverified.message: This language pair has not been checked with the on-device model.

popup_localNoModel.message: No model yet — install it in Settings

popup_disabled.message: This tab is not selected. Turn on the switch to translate it.

options_parallelTranslationHint.message: Default: 8. All translating tabs share this limit in one model runner. Choose 1 for serial translation; higher limits may improve full-page throughput but delay the first result.

options_translationRenderingHint.message: Immediate mode shows available translation without animations or reveal delays. This does not change model generation. Aurora respects reduced-motion preferences.

options_alwaysLanguagesHint.message: The source language is detected automatically. A matching URL or a checked language starts translation in the active tab. Your target language is skipped, even if checked. Turning a tab off overrides automatic translation until that tab closes.

options_rulesHint.message: Use * within one host or path segment and ** across segments: example.com/news/* matches one level; example.com/news/** includes deeper paths. http:// or https:// is optional. Existing Never rules stay blocked until removed.

options_blockedRule.message: This pattern is blocked by an existing Never rule. Remove that rule before adding it.

options_badRule.message: Enter a valid host or URL pattern.

options_localHint.message: Page text is translated by a model running in this browser: nothing is uploaded.

options_pickFileHint.message: Select a PLaMo 3 Translate 0.8B .onnx graph together with tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json and config.json.

options_noModels.message: No model has been downloaded yet.

options_notPersisted.message: storage is not pinned, so the browser may evict the model

options_noSpace.message: Not enough room: $1$ would be needed.

options_prepared.message: The selected model is ready to translate.

options_localUnsupported.message: This browser cannot run the model: WebGPU is missing or has no adapter.

welcome_intro.message: Set up an on-device model. Translate tabs manually, or configure automatic URLs and source languages in Settings.

welcome_modelHint.message: Download the model once, or pick a model file you already have. It is stored on this device; pages never leave the browser.

welcome_haveFile.message: Choose a file I already have

welcome_needModel.message: No model yet. Download it or pick a file to continue.

welcome_readyExisting.message: The model is installed. Finish setup, then turn on a tab or configure automatic translation in Settings.

welcome_done.message: Model ready. Turn on a tab or configure automatic translation in Settings.

options_modelStored.message: Model stored, but it did not load: $1$

welcome_modelStored.message: The file is stored, but it did not load: $1$

glossary_hint.message: Sync concept and expression databases to this browser. Translation only reads the local copy and uses the model's native glossary. When one source term has several counterparts, the one marked as the base form or named by the source usage note is used; entries that cannot be resolved or have no counterpart are omitted. Only dictionary synchronization contacts Notion; page text is not uploaded. Grant a Notion connection read access to both original databases.

glossary_enabled.message: Use the saved glossary and enable scheduled synchronization

glossary_tokenSaved.message: A token is saved. Leave blank to keep it. Stored locally, not encrypted; never shared with web pages or the model.

glossary_tokenMissing.message: Enter your own read-access token. It stays in trusted extension storage, not encrypted. Do not use a shared application secret.

glossary_clearToken.message: Remove the saved token when saving

glossary_sourceHint.message: The shared page reads the view URL of a Notion database published with "Share to web". Both URLs are pre-filled, so a published database syncs as-is. No token and no server; edits appear on the next sync.

glossary_interval.message: Synchronization interval (while the browser is running)

glossary_schemaHint.message: Set existing Notion column names or property IDs. No database columns are changed. The expression relation must point to exactly one concept page; the concept's UUID title is its dictionary identity. Source IDs may be blank only when a database has one data source.

glossary_busy.message: Synchronizing… The last saved dictionary remains available.

glossary_empty.message: No local dictionary. Save connection settings and synchronize.
